correctness.rationale: Derived centered-coordinate moment matrix with positive diagonal variances, verified exact reproducing kernel and its mixed-support absolute-row integral, proved strict |a|<b for all 0<w<1 and all latitudes. Differentiation gives a degree-six necessary stationary polynomial; including endpoints and cusp makes the finite root maximum exact. Proved the local antipodal threshold via exact one-sided derivative and second derivative at w=1/3, and established global coexistence from a strict off-antipodal comparison plus a uniform endpoint limit and compactness. The companion checker passed exact symbolic identities and independent direct integrals. Root enumeration is a finite recipe, not asserted a radical expression.

value.rationale: Adds an exact worst-case L∞ amplification for an entire natural one-parameter family of least-squares estimators under a single atomic outlier. It determines the finite algebraic evaluation for arbitrary contamination strength and exhibits a qualitative lag between the emergence of a stable local worst-case evaluation and actual global worst-case location, a phenomenon not inferred from generic kernel updates. The phase separation is mathematically structural and practically relevant to worst-case projection stability; no unsupported unique global threshold is asserted.
